name: Dawuda Ibrahim Braimah
title: Chief Labour Officer
photoAlt: Portrait of Dawuda Ibrahim Braimah, Chief Labour Officer of Ghana, in a green suit in his office beside the Ghana flag
homeIntro: The Department's district labour offices and Public Employment Centres exist to serve you, whether you are looking for work or need help at work. Our employment services are free.
bio:
As Chief Labour Officer, Mr Braimah leads the Ghana Labour Department and its nationwide network of district labour offices and Public Employment Centres. He has championed the expansion of free public employment services, including the nationwide JOBS (Just One Bold Step) roadshow and the rollout of the Ghana Labour Market Information System.

Under his leadership the Department is modernising labour administration, strengthening workplace inspection and bringing job services closer to young people in every region.
